one_line: AI infrastructure funding rises, regulators act, safety safeguards tighten, and tech stocks fall.

themes.title: AI hardware financing expands globally
themes.text: AM Intelligence is seeking up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchases. Nvidia is discussing credit guarantees for a 460 MW data center and has committed $3 billion to a Meta equity offering, while Foxconn is preparing a joint project with OpenAI on AI data‑centre racks and hardware.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
Nvidia in talks to back Nscale with credit guarantees for Anthropic data center
Nvidia commits $3 billion to Meta share sale and expands AI infrastructure partnership
Foxconn says new collaboration with OpenAI in works, denies AI bubble

themes.title: Regulators push AI data and competition rules
themes.text: The UK High Court dismissed challenges by Meta, TikTok and X to Ofcom’s data‑request notices. Britain’s competition regulator opened a probe into Meta’s terms for publishers and advertisers. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic announced a shared robots.txt opt‑out token, and OpenAI said it will honor that signal for training preferences.

stories.headline: UK high court rejects Meta, TikTok and X challenge to Ofcom data requests
UK competition regulator probes Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt opt‑out standard
OpenAI says it will honor robots.txt signal for AI training preferences

themes.title: New AI safety measures follow breaches
themes.text: Chinese state‑linked hackers used the DeepSeek model via the ARTEX framework to target over 200 organizations. A malicious version of Anthropic’s Claude Code VS Code extension attempted to install an SSH backdoor affecting up to 5,000 users. OpenAI introduced tighter limits on weapons‑related information for teen ChatGPT users and added expanded safeguards to prevent violence.

stories.headline: China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days
Malicious Claude Code VS Code extension adds SSH backdoor, affecting up to 5,000 users
OpenAI tightens weapons‑related information limits for teen ChatGPT users
OpenAI adds expanded safeguards to ChatGPT for violence prevention

themes.title: AI spending drives tech stock declines
themes.text: Shares of Intel fell up to 30 % and the Nasdaq dropped over 3.5 % as investors reacted to $800.6 bn AI spending by major firms. Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft reported cash‑flow concerns after announcing over $740 bn in capital expenditures this year, contributing to broader market declines.

stories.headline: US tech stocks tumble as AI spending approaches $1 trillion
Big tech AI capex sparks cash‑flow concerns, stocks tumble
